title: Canonical counit-mate base-change transformation for algebraic-space modules
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $X,Y,X',Y'$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ with their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the specified tensor pullbacks, module direct images and adjunctions $a^*\dashv a_*$ [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $h:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$ be arbitrary morphisms with $f\circ h=g\circ f'$. Write $\gamma_{a,b}:a^*b^*\simeq(b\circ a)^*$ for the tensor-normalized composition comparison [def-sfb-space-module-tensor-composition]. Define the square comparison $\alpha:f'^*g^*\simeq h^*f^*$ to be $\gamma_{f',g}$, followed by transport along $g\circ f'=f\circ h$, followed by $\gamma_{h,f}^{-1}$. Define the natural counit composite on modules on $X$ by $\delta_F:f'^*g^*f_*F\xrightarrow{\alpha_{f_*F}}h^*f^*f_*F\xrightarrow{h^*\epsilon_F}h^*F$, where $\epsilon$ is the specified counit for $f$. Define $\beta:g^*f_*\to f'_*h^*$ to be the natural transformation whose component $\beta_F$ is the adjoint of $\delta_F$ under $f'^*\dashv f'_*$. These constructions are defined for every module $F$ and every commuting square; no pullback-square, flatness, affineness, quasi-coherence or finiteness hypothesis is imposed.
